description: React functional component for rendering a Snakes and Ladders game board using a canvas element. It draws the grid, snakes, ladders, and player tokens based on game state from a store.

methods.name: drawBoard
methods.description: Draws the game board grid with numbered cells and alternating colors.

methods.name: drawSnakesAndLadders
methods.description: Draws snakes and ladders on the board connecting specified cells.

methods.name: drawConnection
methods.description: Draws a line representing a snake or ladder between two cells.

methods.name: getCoordinatesForNumber
methods.description: Calculates x and y pixel coordinates for a cell number.

methods.name: drawPlayers
methods.description: Draws the player tokens on the board based on their current positions.
